title: Add stalled Agent-turn detection and recovery affordances.
description: When an Agent-mode turn stays in Thinking with no first token, the UI currently only looks pending. Add a visible stalled state and recovery affordance so users can retry, fall back to a simpler search path, or stop the turn without guessing whether the agent is alive. Acceptance criteria: stalled turns are detected after a bounded wait, the UI surfaces a distinct status, and one recovery action is available from the same turn. Validation: reproduce the local-profile search probe and confirm the stalled state appears instead of an endless pending state.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Evidence: the live local-profile probe kept showing Waiting for first token after the trace had already emitted Context planner and model reasoning events, so the user needs a clearer stalled state and escape hatch.
